cards.name: Curtain Call
cards.text: Easy / Standard [skull]: -1 (-3 instead if you have 3 or more horror on you). [cultist] [tablet] [elder_thing]: -4. If your location has at least 1 horror on it, take 1 horror (from the token pool). If your location has no horror on it, place 1 horror on it instead.
cards.text_cn: 簡單 / 普通 [skull]：-1(如果你身上有3點或以上恐懼，改為-3)。 [cultist] [tablet] [elder_thing]：-4。如果你所在地點有至少1點恐懼，受到1點恐懼(從供應堆拿取)。如果你所在地點沒有恐懼，改為在上面放置1點恐懼。
cards.back_text: Hard / Expert [skull]: -X, where X is the amount of horror on you. (If you have no horror on you, X is 1.) [cultist] [tablet] [elder_thing]: -5. If your location has at least 1 horror on it, take 1 horror (from the token pool). If your location has no horror on it, place 1 horror on it instead.
cards.back_text_cn: 困難 / 專家 [skull]：-X，其中X等於你身上的恐懼數量。(如果你身上沒有恐懼，X等於1。) [cultist] [tablet] [elder_thing]：-5。如果你所在地點有至少1點恐懼，受到1點恐懼(從供應堆拿取)。如果你所在地點沒有恐懼，改為在上面放置1點恐懼。

cards.name: The Third Act
cards.back_text: Search all set-aside cards and the victory display for the Royal Emissary enemy, and spawn it in the Theatre.
cards.back_text_cn: 在放在一邊的卡牌和勝利牌區中查找皇家密使敵人，將其生成在劇院。

cards.name: Encore
cards.text: Forced - After Royal Emissary is added to the victory display: Remove all doom from play and reset the agenda deck to agenda 1a. Then, place 3 doom on that agenda.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 皇家密使加入勝利牌區後：移除場上所有毀滅標記並將密謀牌堆重置到密謀1a。隨後，在該密謀上放置3個毀滅標記。
cards.back_text: Each investigator takes 100 horror (cannot be prevented).
cards.back_text_cn: 每位調查員受到100點恐懼(不能防止)。

cards.name: Awakening
cards.back_text: Choose one of the set-aside locations, at random. Put that location into play, and spawn the set-aside The Man in the Pallid Mask enemy at that location (instead of his normal spawn location). Advance to one of the 3 copies of act 2a, at random. Remove the other 2 copies of act 2a from the game without looking at them.
cards.back_text_cn: 隨機選擇1張放在一邊的地點。將該地點放置入場，並在該地點生成放在一邊的蒼白面具下的男子敵人(代替其原有的生成地點)。 隨機推進到3張場景2a中的1張。移除另外2張場景2a，不要查看。

cards.name: The Stranger
cards.text: Objective - When The Man in the Pallid Mask would be discarded from play, advance.
cards.text_cn: 目標 - 在將要丟棄蒼白面具下的男子時，推進場景。
cards.back_text: Instead of discarding The Man in the Pallid Mask, move him to the Lobby. Add 2 [cultist] tokens to the chaos bag. Place 1 horror on the Theatre. Until the end of the scenario, horror on locations represents spreading flames, and each location with horror gains: "Forced - After you enter this location or end your turn at this location: Test [agility] (3). If you fail, take 1 damage. (Limit once per round.)" Keep this card next to the act deck as a reminder, and advance to act 3a.
cards.back_text_cn: 不要丟棄蒼白面具下的男子，改為將其移動到前廳。 在混亂袋中增加2個[cultist]標記。 在劇院上放置1點恐懼。冒險結束前，地點上的恐懼代表火焰，每個帶有恐懼的地點獲得："強制 - 你進入本地點或在本地點結束回合後：檢定[agility](3)。如果你失敗，受到1點傷害。(每輪限制一次。)" 將本卡牌放在場景牌堆旁作為提示，並且推進到場景3a。

cards.name: The Stranger
cards.text: Objective - When The Man in the Pallid Mask would be discarded from play, advance.
cards.text_cn: 目標 - 在將要丟棄蒼白面具下的男子時，推進場景。
cards.back_text: Instead of discarding The Man in the Pallid Mask, move him to the Lobby. Add 2 [tablet] tokens to the chaos bag. Place 1 horror on the location The Man in the Pallid Mask was moved from. Until the end of the scenario, horror on locations represents the advancing ooze, and each location with horror gains: "Forced - After you leave this location: Test [agility] (4). If you fail, take 1 horror and 1 damage." Keep this card next to the act deck as a reminder, and advance to act 3a.
cards.back_text_cn: 不要丟棄蒼白面具下的男子，改為將其移動到前廳。 在混亂袋中增加2個[tablet]標記。 在蒼白面具下的男子移動時的出發地點放置1點恐懼。冒險結束前，地點上的恐懼代表膨脹的淤泥，每個帶有恐懼的地點獲得："強制 - 在你離開本地點後：檢定[agility](4)。如果你失敗，受到1點恐懼和1點傷害。" 將本卡牌放在場景牌堆旁作為提示，並且推進到場景3a。

cards.name: The Stranger
cards.text: Objective - When The Man in the Pallid Mask would be discarded from play, advance.
cards.text_cn: 目標 - 在將要丟棄蒼白面具下的男子時，推進場景。
cards.back_text: Instead of discarding The Man in the Pallid Mask, move him to the Lobby. Add 2 [elder_thing] tokens to the chaos bag. Place 1 horror on each [[Private]] location. Until the end of the scenario, horror on locations represents flooding water, and each location with horror gains: "Forced - When you would leave this location: Test [agility] (2). If you fail, take 1 damage and cancel the effects of the move. (Limit once per round.)" Keep this card next to the act deck as a reminder, and advance to act 3a.
cards.back_text_cn: 不要丟棄蒼白面具下的男子，改為將其移動到前廳。 在混亂袋中增加2個[elder_thing]標記。 在每個[[私密]]地點放置1點恐懼。冒險結束前，地點上的恐懼代表洪水，每個帶有恐懼的地點獲得："強制 - 在你將要離開本地點時：檢定[agility](2)。如果你失敗，受到1點傷害並取消此次移動的效果。(每輪限制一次。)" 將本卡牌放在場景牌堆旁作為提示，並且推進到場景3a。

cards.name: Curtain Call
cards.text: While The Man in the Pallid Mask is not in play, the Lobby gains: "[action]: Resign." Forced - At the end of the round: Place 1 horror on each location with no horror that is connected to a location with horror. Objective - If each undefeated investigator has resigned, advance.
cards.text_cn: 只要蒼白面具下的男子不在場，前廳獲得："[action]：撤退。" 強制 - 當一輪結束時：帶有恐懼的地點連接的地點如果沒有恐懼，在每個此類地點上放置1點恐懼。 目標 - 如果每位未被擊敗的調查員均已撤退，推進場景。
cards.back_text: The investigators must decide (choose one): - We have to warn the police about what's going on! (→R1) - The police won't believe us. We have to solve this mystery on our own. (→R2)
cards.back_text_cn: 調查員必須選擇(以下一項)： - 我們要去報警，告訴他們這裡出了什麼事！(→結局1) - 警方不會相信我們的。我們必須自己解決這件奇案。(→結局2)

cards.name: Lobby
cards.text: Forced - When Lobby is revealed: Put 2 of the set-aside Lobby Doorway locations into play, at random. [action] [action]: Draw 3 cards.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在翻開前廳時：將放在一邊的2個前廳走廊門口隨機放置入場。 [action][action]：抽取3張卡牌。

cards.name: Balcony
cards.text: Forced - After you perform a move action during which you move from the Balcony to the Theatre: Take 2 damage.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 你執行移動行動從樓座進入劇院後：受到2點傷害。

cards.name: Backstage
cards.text: Forced - When Backstage is revealed: Put 2 of the set-aside Backstage Doorway locations into play, at random. While you are at Backstage, each hidden treachery in your hand counts as 3 cards instead of 1 for the purposes of counting your hand size.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在翻開後臺時：將放在一邊的2個後臺走廊門口隨機放置入場。 你在後臺時，你手牌中每張隱私的詭計卡在計算手牌上限時視為3張，而不是1張。

cards.name: Lighting Box
cards.text: While you are in the Lighting Box, increase the resource cost of each card in your hand by 2.
cards.text_cn: 你在照明室時，你手牌中每張卡牌的資源費用提高2點。

cards.name: Box Office
cards.text: [action]: Gain 5 resources. Remember that you "stole from the box office." (Group limit once per game.)
cards.text_cn: [action]：獲得5資源。記住你"從售票處偷竊。"(團隊每場遊戲限制1次。)

cards.name: Green Room
cards.text: [action] Investigate. You get +3 [intellect] for this investigation. After this skill test ends, discard each card in your hand.
cards.text_cn: [action]調查。你本次調查+3[intellect]。本次技能檢定結束後，丟棄你每張手牌。

cards.name: Dressing Room
cards.text: [action] [action] [action]: Heal 3 horror.
cards.text_cn: [action][action][action]：治癒3點恐懼。

cards.name: Rehearsal Room
cards.text: Forced - After you succeed by 2 or more while investigating the Rehearsal Room: Take 1 horror.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 調查排練廳時你成功並超過難度2點或以上後：受到1點恐懼。

cards.name: Trap Room
cards.text: Forced - After you reveal the Trap Room: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for 1 copy of Swarm of Rats and put it into play engaged with you (2 copies instead if there are 3 or 4 investigators in the game). Shuffle the encounter deck if it is searched.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 翻開機關室後：在遭遇牌堆和棄牌堆中查找1張鼠群，將其放置入場並與你交戰(如果遊戲中有3或4位調查員則改為查找2張鼠群)。如果查找過遭遇牌堆則將其混洗。

cards.name: The Man in the Pallid Mask
cards.text: Spawn - Location farthest from all investigators. Aloof. [action]: Investigate. Your location gets +2 shroud for this investigation. If you succeed, instead of discovering clues, defeat The Man in the Pallid Mask.
cards.text_cn: 生成 - 離所有調查員最遠的地點。 冷漠。 [action]：調查。本次調查中你所在地點+2隱藏值。如果你成功，不發現線索，改為擊敗蒼白面具下的男子。

cards.name: Royal Emissary
cards.text: Prey - Lowest [willpower]. Massive. Hunter. Retaliate. Forced - At the end of the enemy phase: Each investigator at Royal Emissary's location or a connecting location takes 1 horror.
cards.text_cn: 獵物 - [willpower]最低的目標。 龐大。獵手。反擊。 強制 - 當敵軍階段結束時：皇家密使所在地點和其連接地點的每位調查員受到1點恐懼。

cards.name: The Last King
cards.text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: Reveal another token. If you fail, place 1 doom on a [[Possessed]] enemy in play.
[cultist]: -2. If you fail, place 1 of your clues on your location.
[tablet]: -4. If you fail, take 1 horror.
[elder_thing]: -X. X is the shroud value of your location.
cards.text_cn: 簡單 / 普通 [skull]：再抽取一個標記。如果你失敗，在場上的1個[[附身]]敵人上放置1個毀滅標記。(FAQ, v2.0) [cultist]：-2。如果你失敗，將1個你的線索放置到你所在地點上。 [tablet]：-4。如果你失敗，受到1點恐懼。 [elder_thing]：-X。其中X等於你所在地點的隱藏值。
cards.back_text:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: Reveal another token. If you fail, place 1 doom on the [[Possessed]] enemy in play with the most remaining health.
[cultist]: -3. Place 1 of your clues on your location.
[tablet]: -4. Take 1 horror.
[elder_thing]: -X. X is the shroud value of your location. If you fail, take 1 damage.
cards.back_text_cn: 困難 / 專家 [skull]：再抽取一個標記。如果你失敗，在場上剩餘生命值最多的1個[[附身]]敵人上放置1個毀滅標記。(FAQ, v2.0) [cultist]：-3。將1個你的線索放置到你所在地點上。 [tablet]：-4。受到1點恐懼。 [elder_thing]：-X。其中X等於你所在地點的隱藏值。如果你失敗，受到1點傷害。

cards.name: Fashionably Late
cards.back_text:
Find the [[Bystander]] asset with the fewest clues on it. Spawn the set-aside Dianne Devine enemy at that asset's location.
Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.
cards.back_text_cn:
找出線索最少的[[旁人]]支援卡。將放在一邊的黛安娜·迪瓦恩敵人生成在該支援卡所在地點。
將遭遇棄牌堆洗入遭遇牌堆。

cards.name: The Terrifying Truth
cards.text: Forced - When this agenda would advance by reaching its doom threshold: Instead, remove all doom in play and randomly resolve one of the Sickening Reality cards underneath the scenario reference card. If there are no cards underneath the scenario reference card, advance to agenda 2b instead.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在本密謀達到毀滅目標值將要推進時：改為移除場上所有毀滅標記，並結算冒險輔助卡底下的隨機1張令人作嘔的現實。如果冒險輔助卡下沒有卡牌，改為推進到密謀2b。

cards.name: Discovering the Truth
cards.text: Forced - When an investigator is eliminated (by defeat or resignation): Place each of that investigator's clues on this act, instead of placing them at his or her location. Objective - Find as many clues as you can, then get out of this awful place!
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在有調查員退場(撤退或被擊敗)時：將該調查員每個線索放在本場景上，不要放在其所在地點。 目標 - 找出盡量多的線索，然後逃出這個可怕的地方！
cards.back_text: Madness. noun. mad.ness. The state of being mentally ill, especially severely. - Extremely foolish behavior. - A state of frenzied or chaotic activity. - Why are you looking at this side? - There is no reason to flip to Act 1b. - Flip back to Act 1a.
cards.back_text_cn: 【瘋狂】 形容詞，fēng kuáng 因精神錯亂而舉止失常。 - 極其愚蠢的行為。 - 癲狂的狀態或混亂的狀況。 - 你為什麼要看這一面？ - 沒有理由要翻到場景1b。 - 請翻回場景1a。

cards.name: Constance Dumaine
cards.text:
Hunter.
While Constance Dumaine is exhausted, she gets +3 fight.
cards.text_cn:
獵手。
康斯坦絲·杜梅因處於消耗狀態時，她+3攻擊。

cards.name: Jordan Perry
cards.text: Hunter. Forced - At the beginning of the enemy phase: Heal 1 damage from Jordan Perry.
cards.text_cn: 獵手。 強制 - 當敵軍階段開始時：治癒喬丹·佩里上的1點傷害。

cards.name: Ishimaru Haruko
cards.text: Hunter. Forced - After you deal damage to Ishimaru Haruko by an effect other than an attack: Draw the top card of the encounter deck.
cards.text_cn: 獵手。 強制 - 你通過攻擊以外的效果對石丸春子造成傷害後：抽取遭遇牌堆頂上的1張卡牌。

cards.name: Sebastien Moreau
cards.text:
Hunter. Retaliate.
Sebastien Moreau's attacks cannot be canceled.
cards.text_cn:
獵手。反擊。
賽巴斯蒂安·莫羅的攻擊不能被取消。

cards.name: Ashleigh Clarke
cards.text:
Hunter.
Each investigator at Ashleigh Clarke's location does not draw cards during the upkeep phase.
cards.text_cn:
獵手。
補給階段中，阿什莉·克拉克所在地點上每位調查員不抽取卡牌。

cards.name: Foyer
cards.text: [action]: Resign. Having found valuable information about the production, you depart and plan your next move. (If each undefeated investigator has resigned, proceed to "if no resolution was reached" in the Campaign Guide.)
cards.text_cn: [action]：撤退。你已經找到了有關這部劇的寶貴信息，你準備離開並計劃下一步行動。(如果每位未被擊敗的調查員均已撤退，閱讀劇本手冊中"如果未達成任何結局"部分。)

cards.name: Ballroom
cards.text: [reaction] After you perform a parley action in the Ballroom: Gain 2 resources. (Group limit once per phase.)
cards.text_cn: [reaction]你在舞廳執行談判行動後：獲得2資源。(團隊每個階段限制一次。)

cards.name: Living Room
cards.text: [reaction] After you perform a parley action in the Living Room: Draw 1 card. (Group limit once per phase.)
cards.text_cn: [reaction]你在客廳執行談判行動後：抽取1張卡牌。(團隊每個階段限制一次。)

cards.name: Gallery
cards.text: Forced - After you end your turn at the Gallery: Test [willpower] (2). If you fail, place 1 of your clues on the Gallery.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 你在畫廊結束回合後：檢定[willpower](2)。如果你失敗，將你的1個線索放置到畫廊上。

cards.name: Courtyard
cards.text: Forced - After you enter the Courtyard: Discard the top card of the encounter deck. If that card is an enemy, draw it.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 你進入庭院後：丟棄遭遇牌堆頂上的1張卡牌。如果該卡牌是敵人，抽取該卡牌。

cards.name: Dining Room
cards.text: [action]: Heal 1 horror. Then, reveal a random token from the chaos bag. If a [skull] or [auto_fail] symbol is revealed, take 1 horror and place 1 doom on the Dining Room.
cards.text_cn: [action]：治癒1點恐懼。隨後，從混亂袋中隨機抽取1個標記。如果抽出[skull]或[auto_fail]標記，受到1點恐懼並將1個毀滅標記放到餐廳上。

cards.name: Constance Dumaine
cards.text: [action]: Parley. Test [intellect] (3) to ask Constance about the play. If you succeed, take control of 1 of the clues on Constance Dumaine. Forced - When the last clue is removed from Constance Dumaine: Flip this card over and resolve its text.
cards.text_cn: [action]：談判。檢定[intellect](3)來詢問康斯坦絲有關於戲劇的事情。如果成功，拿取康斯坦絲·杜梅因上的1個線索。 強制 - 在移除康斯坦絲·杜梅因上最後1個線索時：將本卡牌翻面結算卡牌文本。

cards.name: Jordan Perry
cards.text: [action] If you have 10 or more resources: Parley. Test [intellect] (2) to fraternize with Jordan. If you succeed, take control of 1 of the clues on Jordan Perry. Forced - When the last clue is removed from Jordan Perry: Flip this card over and resolve its text.
cards.text_cn: [action]如果你有10個或以上的資源：談判。檢定[intellect](2)來與喬丹深入交流。如果成功，拿取喬丹·佩里上的1個線索。 強制 - 在移除喬丹·佩里上最後1個線索時：將本卡牌翻面結算卡牌文本。

cards.name: Ishimaru Haruko
cards.text: [action] If you have 6 or more cards in your hand: Parley. Test [willpower] (2) to question Haruko about the play. If you succeed, take control of 1 of the clues on Ishimaru Haruko. Forced - When the last clue is removed from Ishimaru Haruko: Flip this card over and resolve its text.
cards.text_cn: [action]如果你有6張或以上的手牌：談判。檢定[willpower](2)來詢問春子有關戲劇的事情。如果成功，拿取石丸春子上的1個線索。 強制 - 在移除石丸春子上最後1個線索時：將本卡牌翻面結算卡牌文本。

cards.name: Sebastien Moreau
cards.text: [action]: Parley. Test [willpower] (3) to get information about the production from Sebastien. If you succeed, take control of 1 of the clues on Sebastien Moreau. Forced - When the last clue is removed from Sebastien Moreau: Flip this card over and resolve its text.
cards.text_cn: [action]：談判。檢定[willpower](3)來詢問賽巴斯蒂安有關戲劇的編排情況。如果成功，拿取賽巴斯蒂安·莫羅上的1個線索。 強制 - 在移除賽巴斯蒂安·莫羅上最後1個線索時：將本卡牌翻面結算卡牌文本。

cards.name: Ashleigh Clarke
cards.text: [action] [action]: Parley. You listen to Ashleigh perform. Take control of 1 of the clues on Ashleigh Clarke. Forced - When the last clue is removed from Ashleigh Clarke: Flip this card over and resolve its text.
cards.text_cn: [action][action]：談判。你傾聽阿什莉·克拉克的演唱。拿取阿什莉·克拉克上的1個線索。 強制 - 在移除阿什莉·克拉克上最後1個線索時：將本卡牌翻面結算卡牌文本。

cards.name: Dianne Devine
cards.text: Aloof. Each investigator at Dianne Devine's location cannot discover or take control of clues. Forced - At the beginning of the enemy phase: Find the [[Bystander]] asset with the fewest clues on it. Move Dianne Devine to that asset's location, if able.
cards.text_cn: 冷漠。 黛安娜·迪瓦恩所在地點的所有調查員都不能發現或拿取線索。 強制 - 當敵軍階段開始時：找出線索最少的[[旁人]]支援卡。如果可能，將黛安娜·迪瓦恩移動到該支援卡所在地點。

cards.name: Fine Dining
cards.text: Peril. Revelation - You must either place 1 of your clues on a [[Bystander]] asset in play or take 1 horror and 1 damage.
cards.text_cn: 禍害。 顯現 - 你必須在場上一張[[旁人]]支援卡上放置1個你的線索，或者受到1點恐懼和1點傷害。

cards.name: Tough Crowd
cards.text: Revelation - Put Tough Crowd into play next to the agenda deck. Each investigator must spend 1 additional action to parley. Forced - At the end of the round: Discard Tough Crowd.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 將難纏的客人放置入場，放在密謀牌堆旁邊。 每位調查員必須花費額外1次行動才能談判。 強制 - 當本輪結束時：丟棄難纏的客人。

cards.name: Whispers in Your Head
cards.text: Peril. Hidden. Revelation - Secretly add Whispers in Your Head (Dismay) to your hand. You cannot commit skill cards to skill tests. [action] [action]: Discard Whispers in Your Head (Dismay) from your hand.
cards.text_cn: 禍害。隱私。 顯現 - 將腦海中的低語(沮喪)秘密地加入你的手牌。 你不能在技能檢定時投入技能卡。 [action][action]：丟棄你手牌中的腦海中的低語(沮喪)。

cards.name: Whispers in Your Head
cards.text: Peril. Hidden. Revelation - Secretly add Whispers in Your Head (Dread) to your hand. You cannot move more than once each turn. [action] [action]: Discard Whispers in Your Head (Dread) from your hand.
cards.text_cn: 禍害。隱私。 顯現 - 將腦海中的低語(驚懼)秘密地加入你的手牌。 你每回合最多只能移動一次。 [action][action]：丟棄你手牌中的腦海中的低語(驚懼)。

cards.name: Whispers in Your Head
cards.text: Peril. Hidden. Revelation - Secretly add Whispers in Your Head (Anxiety) to your hand. You cannot trigger [fast] abilities. [action] [action]: Discard Whispers in Your Head (Anxiety) from your hand.
cards.text_cn: 禍害。隱私。 顯現 - 將腦海中的低語(焦慮)秘密地加入你的手牌。 你不能觸發[free]能力。 [action][action]：丟棄你手牌中的腦海中的低語(焦慮)。

cards.name: Whispers in Your Head
cards.text: Peril. Hidden. Revelation - Secretly add Whispers in Your Head (Doubt) to your hand. You cannot play events. [action] [action]: Discard Whispers in Your Head (Doubt) from your hand.
cards.text_cn: 禍害。隱私。 顯現 - 將腦海中的低語(疑惑)秘密地加入你的手牌。 你不能打出事件卡。 [action][action]：丟棄你手牌中的腦海中的低語(疑惑)。

cards.name: Descent into Madness
cards.text: Surge. Revelation - If you have at least 3 horror on you, lose 1 action.
cards.text_cn: 湧動。 顯現 - 如果你擁有至少3點恐懼，失去1次行動。

cards.name: Swift Byakhee
cards.text: Prey - Lowest remaining sanity. Hunter. Retaliate. Forced - When Swift Byakhee would move via the hunter keyword: Instead, move it (one location at a time) until it enters its prey's location. If it moved more than one location by this effect, it does not attack this phase.
cards.text_cn: 獵物 - 剩餘神智值最低的目標。 獵手。 反擊。 強制 - 在迅捷的拜亞基通過獵手關鍵詞移動時：改為它每次移動一個地點，直到進入其獵物所在地點。如果它通過本效果移動了超過一個地點，它本階段不會攻擊。

cards.name: Hunted by Byakhee
cards.text: Revelation - Test [agility] (6). If you fail, reveal the top X cards of the encounter deck, where X is the amount you failed by. If at least 1 [[Byakhee]] enemy is revealed by this effect, choose and draw 1 of them. If at least 1 [[Omen]] treachery is revealed by this effect, take 1 horror. Shuffle the encounter deck.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 檢定[agility](6)。如果你失敗，翻開遭遇牌堆頂部的X張卡，其中X等於你低於難度的點數。如果本效果翻開了至少1個[[拜亞基]]敵人，在其中選擇並抽取1張。如果本效果翻開了至少1個[[徵兆]]詭計，受到1點恐懼。混洗遭遇牌堆。

cards.name: Beast of Aldebaran
cards.text:
Massive.
While assigning damage and horror from Beast of Aldebaran's attack, you must assign as much damage and horror as possible to a single card before assigning it to another card.
cards.text_cn:
龐大。
分配畢宿五的野獸造成的傷害和恐懼時，你必須對單張卡分配盡可能多的傷害和恐懼之後，才能分配到另一張卡上。

cards.name: Spawn of Hali
cards.text: Prey - Most horror. Retaliate. Forced - After you successfully evade Spawn of Hali by 2 or less: Take 1 horror.
cards.text_cn: 獵物 - 恐懼最多的目標。 反擊。 強制 - 在你成功躲避哈利湖水怪，但高於難度2點或以下後：受到1點恐懼。

cards.name: Black Stars Rise
cards.text: Revelation - Test [intellect] (4). If you fail, you must either place 1 doom on the current agenda or take 1 horror for each point you failed by. This effect can cause the current agenda to advance.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 檢定[intellect](4)。如果你失敗，你必須在當前密謀上放置1點毀滅標記，或者每低於難度1點你受到1點恐懼。本效果可能推進當前密謀。

cards.name: Spires of Carcosa
cards.text: Revelation - Attach to your location, then place 2 doom on that location. If there is no doom on attached location, discard Spires of Carcosa. [action]: Investigate. If you succeed, instead of discovering clues here, remove 1 doom from attached location.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 疊加到你所在地點，然後在該地點放置2個毀滅標記。 如果被疊加的地點上沒有毀滅標記，丟棄卡爾克薩尖柱。 [action]：調查。如果你成功，不發現這裡的線索，改為移除被疊加地點上的1個毀滅標記。

cards.name: Twisted to His Will
cards.text: Revelation - If there is no doom in play, Twisted to His Will gains surge. Otherwise, test [willpower] (X), where X is the amount of doom in play. If you fail, discard 2 cards from your hand at random.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 如果場上沒有毀滅標記，邪念扭曲獲得湧動。否則，檢定[willpower](X)，其中X等於場上毀滅標記的數量。如果你失敗，隨機丟棄你手牌中的2張卡牌。

cards.name: Poltergeist
cards.text: Cannot be damaged except by [[Spell]], [[Relic]], or encounter cards. [action] Parley. Test [intellect] (3) to attempt to banish the geist. If you succeed, deal it 1 damage.
cards.text_cn: 不能受到來自[[法術]]、[[遺物]]和遭遇卡以外的傷害。 [action]談判。檢定[intellect](3)來驅逐此靈怪。如果你成功，對其造成1點傷害。

cards.name: Spirit's Torment
cards.text: Revelation - Attach to your location. Forced - After you leave attached location: You must either take 1 horror or lose 1 action. [action] Place 1 of your clues on attached location: Discard Spirit's Torment.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 疊加到你所在地點。 強制 - 在你離開被疊加的地點後：你必須受到1點恐懼或失去1次行動。 [action]將你的1個線索放置到被疊加的地點上：丟棄惡靈作祟。

cards.name: Seer of the Sign
cards.text: Forced - After Maniac engages you: Take 1 damage and deal 1 damage to Maniac.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在印記幻想者與你交戰後：受到1點傷害並對印記幻想者造成1點傷害。

cards.name: Puppet of Hastur
cards.text: Forced - After Young Psychopath engages you: You must either take 1 horror, or Young Psychopath gets +3 fight until the end of the investigation phase.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在哈斯塔的魁儡與你交戰後：你必須受到1點恐懼，或者調查階段結束前哈斯塔的魁儡獲得+3攻擊。

cards.name: Dance of the Yellow King
cards.text: Revelation - If there are no [[Possessed]] enemies in play, Dance of the Yellow King gains surge. Otherwise, test [willpower] (3). If you fail, the nearest [[Possessed]] enemy readies, moves (one location at a time) until it reaches your location, engages you, and makes an immediate attack.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 如果場上沒有[[附身]]敵人，黃衣之王之舞獲得湧動。否則，檢定[willpower](3)。如果你失敗，最近的[[附身]]敵人準備並移動(每次一個地點)，直到它到達你所在地點，與你交戰，並立即進行一次攻擊。(FAQ, v2.0)

cards.name: Fanatic
cards.text: Spawn - Revealed location with the most clues. Forced - After Fanatic enters play: Move 1 clue from Fanatic's location to Fanatic. Forced - When you defeat Fanatic: Take control of all of its clues.
cards.text_cn: 生成 - 線索最多的已揭示地點。 強制 - 在狂徒入場後：將1個線索從狂徒所在地點移到狂徒上。 強制 - 在你擊敗狂徒時：拿取其所有線索。

cards.name: Agent of the King
cards.text: Prey - Most clues. Hunter. Forced - After Agent of the King attacks you: Move 1 of your clues to Agent of the King. Forced - When you defeat Agent of the King: Take control of all of its clues.
cards.text_cn: 獵物 - 線索最多的目標。 獵手。 強制 - 在王之特使攻擊你後：將你的1個線索移動到王之特使上。 強制 - 在你擊敗王之特使時：拿取其所有線索。

cards.name: The King's Edict
cards.text: Revelation - For each [[Cultist]] enemy in play, move 1 clue from that enemy's location to that enemy. Until the end of the round, each [[Cultist]] enemy in play gets +1 fight for each clue and/or doom on it. If no clues are moved by this effect, The King's Edict gains surge.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 場上每有一個[[異教徒]]敵人，移動該敵人所在地點的1個線索到該敵人上。本輪結束前，場上每個[[異教徒]]敵人上每個線索和毀滅標記使其+1攻擊。如果本效果沒有移動任何線索，王之法令獲得湧動。

cards.name: Ooze and Filth
cards.text: Revelation - Put Ooze and Filth into play next to the act deck. Each location gets +1 shroud. Forced - At the end of the round: Discard Ooze and Filth.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 將淤泥與汙物放置入場，在密謀牌堆旁邊。 每個地點+1隱藏值。 強制 - 當本輪結束時：丟棄淤泥與汙物。

cards.name: Corrosion
cards.text: Revelation - Discard [[Item]] assets from your play area and/or from your hand with a total printed resource cost of at least X, where X is the shroud value of your location. If no cards are discarded by this effect, Corrosion gains surge.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 從你遊戲區域和/或你手牌中丟棄一定數量的[[道具]]支援卡，且這些卡牌上印刷的費用總計至少為X，其中X等於你所在地點的隱藏值。如果本效果沒有丟棄任何卡牌，銹蝕獲得湧動。(FAQ, v1.2)

cards.name: Roach Swarm
cards.text: X is the shroud value of Roach Swarm's location.
cards.text_cn: X等於蟑螂群所在地點的隱藏值。

cards.name: Marked by the Sign
cards.text: Peril. Revelation - Test [willpower] (2). If you fail, take 2 horror. If The Man in the Pallid Mask is in play, horror dealt by this effect is considered direct horror, and this test has +2 difficulty.
cards.text_cn: 禍害。 顯現 - 檢定[willpower](2)。如果你失敗，受到2點恐懼。如果蒼白面具下的男子在場上，本效果造成的恐懼視為直接恐懼，且本次檢定+2難度。

cards.name: The Pale Mask Beckons
cards.text: Revelation - If The Man in the Pallid Mask is in play, he attacks each investigator in player order, regardless of his current location. If The Man in the Pallid Mask is not in play, search his bearer's deck and discard pile for him, draw him, and shuffle his bearer's deck (resolve this effect even if his bearer is currently eliminated, searching all out-of-play areas).
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 如果蒼白面具下的男子在場上，他按玩家順序攻擊每位調查員，無視他當前所在地點。如果蒼白面具下的男子不在場上，查找其承受者的牌組和棄牌堆，抽取這張卡，並混洗其承受者的牌組(如果其承受者已經退場，查找所有遊戲外區域來結算本效果。)

cards.name: Echoes of the Past
cards.text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is the highest number of doom on an enemy in play.
[cultist]: -2. If you fail, place 1 doom on the nearest enemy.
[tablet]: -2. If you fail, discard a random card from your hand.
[elder_thing]: -2. If you fail and there is an enemy at your location, take 1 horror.
cards.text_cn: 簡單 / 普通 [skull]：-X。其中X為場上單張敵人上最多毀滅標記的數量。 [cultist]：-2。如果你失敗，在最近的敵人上放置1個毀滅標記。 [tablet]：-2。如果你失敗，隨機丟棄你手牌中的1張卡牌。 [elder_thing]：-2。如果你失敗且你所在地點有敵人，受到1點恐懼。
cards.back_text:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -X. X is the total number of doom on enemies in play.
[cultist]: -4. Place 1 doom on the nearest enemy.
[tablet]: -4. Discard a random card from your hand.
[elder_thing]: -4. If there is an enemy at your location, take 1 horror.
cards.back_text_cn: 困難 / 專家 [skull]：-X。其中X為場上敵人上毀滅標記的總數量。 [cultist]：-4。在最近的敵人上放置1個毀滅標記。 [tablet]：-4。隨機丟棄你手牌中的1張卡牌。 [elder_thing]：-4。如果你所在地點有敵人，受到1點恐懼。

cards.name: The Truth is Hidden
cards.text: Skip the 'Place 1 doom on the current agenda' step of the Mythos phase. Forced - After 1 or more clues are placed on an enemy in play: Flip those clues to their doom side.
cards.text_cn: 神話階段中，跳過"在當前密謀上放置1個毀滅標記"步驟。(FAQ, v1.2) 強制 - 有1點或以上線索放置到在場的敵人後：將這些線索翻面為毀滅標記。
cards.back_text: Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.
cards.back_text_cn: 將遭遇棄牌堆洗入遭遇牌堆。

cards.name: Ransacking the Manor
cards.text: Skip the 'Place 1 doom on the current agenda' step of the Mythos phase. Forced - After 1 or more clues are placed on an enemy in play: Flip those clues to their doom side.
cards.text_cn: 神話階段中，跳過"在當前密謀上放置1個毀滅標記"步驟。(FAQ, v1.2) 強制 - 有1點或以上線索放置到在場的敵人後：將這些線索翻面為毀滅標記。
cards.back_text: Spawn the set-aside Possessed Oathspeaker enemy at the Entry Hall. Check Campaign Log. If Sebastien Moreau is not listed under "VIPs Slain," search the collection for Sebastien Moreau (Savage Hysteria) and spawn him in the Entry Hall.
cards.back_text_cn: 將放在一邊的附身宣誓者敵人生成在入口大廳。 查看冒險日誌。如果"貴賓遇害"下沒有賽巴斯蒂安·莫羅，搜索收藏中的賽巴斯蒂安·莫羅(歇斯底里的蠻子)並生成在入口大廳。

cards.name: Secrets Better Left Hidden
cards.text: Skip the 'Place 1 doom on the current agenda' step of the Mythos phase. Forced - After 1 or more clues are placed on an enemy in play: Flip those clues to their doom side.
cards.text_cn: 神話階段中，跳過"在當前密謀上放置1個毀滅標記"步驟。(FAQ, v1.2) 強制 - 有1點或以上線索放置到在場的敵人後：將這些線索翻面為毀滅標記。

cards.name: Race for Answers
cards.back_text: For each revealed Historical Society location, add 1 [per_investigator] clues to it (to a maximum of its clue value).
cards.back_text_cn: 在每個已揭示的歷史協會地點增加1[per_investigator]的線索(上限為其本身線索數值)。

cards.name: Mistakes of the Past
cards.back_text:
For each revealed Historical Society location, add 1 [per_investigator] clues to it (to a maximum of its clue value).
Choose an investigator to take control of the set-aside Mr. Peabody asset.
Put the set-aside Hidden Library location into play.
cards.back_text_cn:
在每個已揭示的歷史協會地點增加1[per_investigator]的線索(上限為其本身線索數值)。
選擇1位調查員來控制放在一邊的皮博迪先生支援卡。
將放在一邊的隱藏的圖書館地點放置入場。

cards.name: The Oath
cards.text: Locations with the [[Passageway]] trait are connected to one another. Objective - Only investigators in the Hidden Library may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
cards.text_cn: 擁有[[通道]]屬性的地點視為互相連接。 目標 - 只有隱藏的圖書館中的調查員可以以團隊為單位，花費所需數量的線索來推進場景。
cards.back_text: The investigators must decide (choose one): - This is an important discovery! We should take it with us. (→R1). - It's just a silly trinket, and it would be wrong to steal from the Historical Society. Leave it behind. (→R2)
cards.back_text_cn: 調查員必須選擇(一項)： - 這可是重大發現！我們應該拿走它。(→結局1) - 這只是個無聊的小配飾，而且我們也不應該偷歷史協會的東西。把它留下。(→結局2)

cards.name: Entry Hall
cards.text: Entry Hall is connected to each other [[Ground Floor]] location. [action]: Resign. You flee, leaving the mysteries of the past to the mysterious cultists.
cards.text_cn: 入口大廳連接著每個其他[[一樓]]地點。 [action]：撤退。你逃走了，把過去的謎團留給那些神秘的異教徒。
cards.back_text: Entry Hall is connected to each other [[Ground Floor]] location.
cards.back_text_cn: 入口大廳連接著每個其他[[一樓]]地點。

cards.name: Historical Society
cards.text: [action] Exhaust an [[Ally]] asset: Discover a clue at this location. (Limit once per round.)
cards.text_cn: [action]消耗一張[[盟友]]支援卡：發現本地點的1個線索。(每輪限制一次。)
cards.back_text: Forced - When an enemy spawns at this location: Reveal this location.
cards.back_text_cn: 強制 - 在敵人生成在本地點時：翻開本地點。

cards.name: Historical Society
cards.text: Each enemy at this location gets +1 fight and +1 evade.
cards.text_cn: 本地點上每個敵人+1攻擊並+1躲避。
cards.back_text: Forced - When an enemy spawns at this location: Reveal this location.
cards.back_text_cn: 強制 - 在敵人生成在本地點時：翻開本地點。

cards.name: Historical Society
cards.text: While investigating this location, your [intellect] cannot be increased.
cards.text_cn: 調查本地點時，不能提升你的[intellect]。(FAQ, v1.2)
cards.back_text: Forced - When an enemy spawns at this location: Reveal this location.
cards.back_text_cn: 強制 - 在敵人生成在本地點時：翻開本地點。

cards.name: Quiet Halls
cards.text: Quiet Halls is connected to each other [[Second Floor]] location. [action] If each location in play is revealed and there are no clues on locations in play: Place 1 [per_investigator] clues on Quiet Halls (from the token bank).
cards.text_cn: 寧靜的走廊連接著每個其他[[二樓]]地點。 [action]如果場上每個地點都已揭示，且場上所有地點均沒有線索：在寧靜的走廊放置1[per_investigator]線索(從供應堆拿取)。
cards.back_text: Quiet Halls is connected to each other [[Second Floor]] location.
cards.back_text_cn: 寧靜的走廊連接著每個其他[[二樓]]地點。

cards.name: Historical Society
cards.text: While investigating this location, your [intellect] cannot be increased.
cards.text_cn: 調查本地點時，不能提升你的[intellect]。(FAQ, v1.2)
cards.back_text: Forced - When an enemy spawns at this location: Reveal this location.
cards.back_text_cn: 強制 - 在敵人生成在本地點時：翻開本地點。

cards.name: Historical Society
cards.text: [reaction] After you successfully investigate this location, take 2 horror: Discover 1 clue at this location. (Limit once per round).
cards.text_cn: [reaction]你成功調查本地點後，受到2點恐懼：發現本地點的1個線索。(每輪限制一次。)
cards.back_text: Forced - When an enemy spawns at this location: Reveal this location.
cards.back_text_cn: 強制 - 在敵人生成在本地點時：翻開本地點。

cards.name: Historical Society
cards.text: [action]: Investigate. If you succeed, instead of discovering clues, choose an enemy with doom on it. Take 1 of that enemy's doom, flip it to its clue side, and place it on your investigator. (Group limit once per round).
cards.text_cn: [action]：調查。如果你成功，不發現線索，改為選擇1個有毀滅標記的敵人。拿取該敵人上的1個毀滅標記，將其翻面為線索，並放置到你的調查員上。(團隊每輪限制一次。)
cards.back_text: Forced - When an enemy spawns at this location: Reveal this location.
cards.back_text_cn: 強制 - 在敵人生成在本地點時：翻開本地點。

cards.name: Quiet Halls
cards.text: Quiet Halls is connected to each other [[Third Floor]] location. [action] If each location in play is revealed and there are no clues on locations in play: Place 1 [per_investigator] clues on Quiet Halls (from the token bank).
cards.text_cn: 寧靜的走廊連接著每個其他[[三樓]]地點。 [action]如果場上每個地點都已揭示，且場上所有地點均沒有線索：在寧靜的走廊放置1[per_investigator]線索(從供應堆拿取)。
cards.back_text: Quiet Halls is connected to each other [[Third Floor]] location.
cards.back_text_cn: 寧靜的走廊連接著每個其他[[三樓]]地點。

cards.name: Historical Society
cards.text: [reaction] After you successfully investigate this location, take 2 horror: Discover 1 clue at this location. (Limit once per round).
cards.text_cn: [reaction]你成功調查本地點後，受到2點恐懼：發現本地點的1個線索。(每輪限制一次。)
cards.back_text: Forced - When an enemy spawns at this location: Reveal this location.
cards.back_text_cn: 強制 - 在敵人生成在本地點時：翻開本地點。

cards.name: Historical Society
cards.text: While an investigator at this location controls Mr. Peabody, this location gets -2 shroud.
cards.text_cn: 本地點的調查員控制皮博迪先生時，本地點-2隱藏值。
cards.back_text: Forced - When an enemy spawns at this location: Reveal this location.
cards.back_text_cn: 強制 - 在敵人生成在本地點時：翻開本地點。

cards.name: Historical Society
cards.text: Each enemy at this location gets +1 fight and +1 evade.
cards.text_cn: 本地點上每個敵人+1攻擊並+1躲避。
cards.back_text: Forced - When an enemy spawns at this location: Reveal this location.
cards.back_text_cn: 強制 - 在敵人生成在本地點時：翻開本地點。

cards.name: Hidden Library
cards.text: While an enemy is moving, Hidden Library gains the [[Passageway]] trait.
cards.text_cn: 敵人移動時，隱藏的圖書館獲得[[通道]]屬性。
cards.back_text: While an enemy is moving, Hidden Library gains the [[Passageway]] trait.
cards.back_text_cn: 敵人移動時，隱藏的圖書館獲得[[通道]]屬性。

cards.name: Possessed Oathspeaker
cards.text: Hunter. Retaliate. Cannot be damaged during act 1 or act 2. Forced - At the beginning of the enemy phase: The investigators must either ready Possessed Oathspeaker or place 1 doom on it. Objective - If Possessed Oathspeaker is defeated: (→R3)
cards.text_cn: 獵手。反擊。 在場景1和場景2中不能受到傷害。 強制 - 當敵軍階段開始時：調查員必須準備附身宣誓者或者在其身上放置1個毀滅標記。 目標 - 如果擊敗附身宣誓者：(→結局3)

cards.name: Mr. Peabody
cards.text: [action] Exhaust Mr. Peabody: Choose a location. Until Mr. Peabody readies, that location gets -1 shroud and gains the [[Passageway]] trait.
cards.text_cn: [action]消耗皮博迪先生：選擇一個地點。在皮博迪先生準備前，該地點隱藏值-1並獲得[[通道]]屬性。

cards.name: Clasp of Black Onyx
cards.text: While Clasp of Black Onyx is in your hand, increase the cost of each other card in your hand by 1.
cards.text_cn: 只要黑瑪瑙扣環在你手中，你手牌中每張其他卡牌的費用增加1點。

cards.name: The Tattered Cloak
cards.text:
You get -1 sanity.
You get +1 [willpower], +1 [combat], and +1 [agility] while you have 3 or fewer remaining sanity.
cards.text_cn:
你-1神智值。
你剩餘神智值為3點或更少時，你+1[willpower]，+1[combat]，+1[agility]。

cards.name: Seeker of Carcosa
cards.text: Spawn - Any empty Historical Society location. Aloof. Forced - At the end of the mythos phase: Move 1 clue from Seeker of Carcosa's location to Seeker of Carcosa (if you cannot, place 1 doom on Seeker of Carcosa, instead).
cards.text_cn: 生成 - 歷史協會任意一個無人地點。 冷漠。 強制 - 當神話階段結束時：將卡爾克薩探求者所在地點的1個線索移動到卡爾克薩探求者上(如果你不能這麼做，改為在卡爾克薩探求者上放置1個毀滅標記)。

cards.name: Led Astray
cards.text: Peril. Revelation - You must decide (choose one): - Place 1 of your clues on a [[Cultist]] enemy. - Place 1 doom on the current agenda (this effect may cause the current agenda to advance).
cards.text_cn: 禍害。 顯現 - 你必須選擇(以下一項)： - 將1個你的線索放置到一個[[異教徒]]敵人上。 - 在當前密謀上放置1個毀滅標記(本效果可能推進當前密謀)。

cards.name: The Cult's Search
cards.text: Revelation - If there is a [[Cultist]] enemy in play with doom on it, move all doom from each [[Cultist]] enemy to the current agenda (this effect may cause the current agenda to advance). If there are no [[Cultist]] enemies in play with doom on them, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Cultist]] enemy and draw it (shuffle the encounter deck).
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 如果場上的[[異教徒]]敵人有毀滅標記，將每個[[異教徒]]敵人的所有毀滅標記移動到當前密謀上(本效果可能推進當前密謀)。如果場上的[[異教徒]]敵人沒有毀滅標記，在遭遇牌堆和棄牌堆中查找並抽取一張[[異教徒]]敵人(混洗遭遇牌堆)。

cards.name: The Unspeakable Oath
cards.text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -1. If you fail, randomly choose an enemy from among the set-aside [[Monster]] enemies and place it beneath the act deck without looking at it.
[cultist]: -X. X is the amount of horror on you.
[tablet]: -X. X is the base shroud value of your location.
[elder_thing]: 0. Either randomly choose an enemy from among the set-aside [[Monster]] enemies and place it beneath the act deck without looking at it, or this test automatically fails instead.
cards.text_cn: 簡單 / 普通 [skull]：-1。如果你失敗，從放在一邊的[[怪物]]敵人中隨機選擇1個放在場景牌堆下，不要查看。(每次檢定限制1次。) [cultist]：-X。其中X為你身上的恐懼數量。 [tablet]：-X。其中X等於你所在地點的基礎隱藏值。 [elder_thing]：0。從放在一邊的[[怪物]]敵人中隨機選擇1個放在場景牌堆下，不要查看，或者本次檢定自動失敗。
cards.back_text:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: Reveal another token. If you fail, randomly choose an enemy from among the set-aside [[Monster]] enemies and place it beneath the act deck without looking at it. (Limit once per test.)
[cultist]: -X. X is the amount of horror on you. If you fail, take 1 horror.
[tablet]: -X. X is the base shroud value of your location. If you fail, take 1 horror.
[elder_thing]: 0. Either randomly choose an enemy from among the set-aside [[Monster]] enemies and place it beneath the act deck without looking at it, or this test automatically fails instead.
cards.back_text_cn: 困難 / 專家 [skull]：再抽取1個標記。如果你失敗，從放在一邊的[[怪物]]敵人中隨機選擇1個放在場景牌堆下，不要查看。(每次檢定限制1次。) [cultist]：-X。其中X為你身上的恐懼數量。如果你失敗，受到1點恐懼。 [tablet]：-X。其中X等於你所在地點的基礎隱藏值。如果你失敗，受到1點恐懼。 [elder_thing]：0。從放在一邊的[[怪物]]敵人中隨機選擇1個放在場景牌堆下，不要查看，或者本次檢定自動失敗。

cards.name: Locked Inside
cards.back_text:
Shuffle the encounter discard pile and each of the set-aside [[Possessed]] enemies into the encounter deck.
The lead investigator must randomly choose an enemy from among the set-aside [[Monster]] enemies and place it beneath the act deck without looking at it.
cards.back_text_cn: 將遭遇棄牌堆和放在一邊的每張[[附身]]敵人洗入遭遇牌堆。(FAQ, v2.0) 隊長必須從放在一邊的[[怪物]]敵人中隨機選擇1個放在場景牌堆下，不要查看。

cards.name: Torturous Descent
cards.back_text: The lead investigator must randomly choose an enemy from among the set-aside [[Monster]] enemies and shuffle it into the encounter deck without looking at it. Check Campaign Log. If Constance Dumaine is not listed under "VIPs Slain," search the collection for Constance Dumaine (A Little Too Sociable) and spawn her in the Garden.
cards.back_text_cn: 隊長必須從放在一邊的[[怪物]]敵人中隨機選擇1個洗入遭遇牌堆，不要查看。 查看冒險日誌。如果"貴賓遇害"下沒有康斯坦絲·杜梅因，搜索收藏中的康斯坦絲·杜梅因(過度社交)並生成在花園。

cards.name: His Domain
cards.text: Forced - When you would place an enemy beneath the act deck: Shuffle that enemy into the encounter deck, instead.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在你將要把1個敵人放到場景牌堆下時：改為將該敵人洗入遭遇牌堆。
cards.back_text: Each investigator who has not resigned is defeated. (If any investigators resigned, those investigators may immediately advance to act 4b.)
cards.back_text_cn: 每位尚未撤退的調查員被擊敗。(如果有調查員撤退，這些調查員可以立即推進到場景4b。)

cards.name: Arkham Asylum
cards.back_text:
The investigators must decide (choose one):
- Any investigator tests [combat] (4) to intimidate her into giving you the keys. If successful, advance to act 2a. If failed, you must choose an option you have yet to choose.
- Any investigator tests [agility] (4) to steal the keys from her. If successful, advance to act 2a. If failed, you must choose an option you have yet to choose.
- Any investigator tests [intellect] (4) to persuade her to give you the keys. If successful, advance to act 2a. If failed, you must choose an option you have yet to choose.
- You knock her over and grab the keys. Remember that "you took the keys by force." Advance to act 2a.
cards.back_text_cn:
調查員必須選擇(以下一項)：
- 任意一位調查員檢定[combat](4)來威脅她交出鑰匙。如果成功，推進到場景2a。如果失敗，你必須選擇另一個尚未選擇過的選項。
- 任意一位調查員檢定[agility](4)來偷她的鑰匙。如果成功，推進到場景2a。如果失敗，你必須選擇另一個尚未選擇過的選項。
- 任意一位調查員檢定[intellect](4)來說服她交出鑰匙。如果成功，推進到場景2a。如果失敗，你必須選擇另一個尚未選擇過的選項。
- 你擊暈了她，奪走了鑰匙。記住你"強行奪走了鑰匙"。推進到場景2a。

cards.name: "The Really Bad Ones" (v. I)
cards.text: Ignore the text on the unrevealed side of [[Arkham Asylum]] locations. Objective - Find the Patient Confinement location with Daniel Chesterfield. (You will be instructed when to advance.)
cards.text_cn: 忽略[[阿卡姆瘋人院]]地點未揭示面上的文字。 目標 - 找到關著丹尼爾·契斯特菲爾德的病人拘禁室地點。(得到指示時推進場景。)
cards.back_text: Choose an investigator at Patient Confinement (Daniel's Cell). Put the set-aside Daniel Chesterfield card (asset side faceup) into play under that investigator's control. Shuffle the encounter discard pile and each enemy beneath the act deck into the encounter deck.
cards.back_text_cn: 選擇病人拘禁室(丹尼爾的囚室)中的一位調查員。將放在一邊的丹尼爾·契斯特菲爾德(支援面朝上)放置入場，置於該調查員的控制下。 將遭遇棄牌堆和場景牌堆下的每張敵人洗入遭遇牌堆。

cards.name: "The Really Bad Ones" (v. II)
cards.text: Ignore the text on the unrevealed side of [[Arkham Asylum]] locations. Objective - Find the Patient Confinement location with Daniel Chesterfield. (You will be instructed when to advance.)
cards.text_cn: 忽略[[阿卡姆瘋人院]]地點未揭示面上的文字。 目標 - 找到關著丹尼爾·契斯特菲爾德的病人拘禁室地點。(得到指示時推進場景。)
cards.back_text: Spawn the set-aside Daniel Chesterfield (enemy side faceup) at Patient Confinement (Daniel's Cell).
cards.back_text_cn: 將放在一邊的丹尼爾·契斯特菲爾德(敵人面朝上)生成在病人拘禁室(丹尼爾的囚室)。

cards.name: Planning the Escape
cards.text: Ignore the text on the unrevealed side of [[Arkham Asylum]]locations. Objective - If investigators have performed 4 of the following, you must advance. - "Know the guards' patrols." - "Set a fire in the kitchen." - "Incited a fight amongst the patients." - "Released a dangerous patient." - "Recalled the way out." - "Distracted the guards."
cards.text_cn: 忽略[[阿卡姆瘋人院]]地點未揭示面上的文字。 目標 - 如果調查員達成了以下4個條件，你必須推進場景。 - "獲知了守衛的巡邏路線。" - "在廚房放了火。" - "煽動病人互相攻擊。" - "釋放了一個危險的病人。" - "想起了出去的路。" - "分散了守衛的注意力"
cards.back_text:
Shuffle the encounter discard pile and each enemy beneath the act deck into the encounter deck.
If at least 3 [[Monster]] enemies were shuffled into the encounter deck by this effect, the investigator with the lowest [willpower] discards cards from the top of the encounter deck until a [[Monster]] enemy is discarded and draws that enemy.
cards.back_text_cn:
將遭遇棄牌堆和場景牌堆下的每張敵人洗入遭遇牌堆。
如果至少3個[[怪物]]敵人因本效果洗入遭遇牌堆，[willpower]最低的調查員從遭遇牌堆頂開始棄牌，直到棄掉1個[[怪物]]敵人時抽取該敵人。

cards.name: No Asylum
cards.text: Ignore the text on the unrevealed side of Arkham Asylum locations. Garden gains: "[action] If there is no ready enemy in the Garden: Resign. Finally, a way out!" Objective - If each undefeated investigator has resigned, advance.
cards.text_cn: 忽略[[阿卡姆瘋人院]]地點未揭示面上的文字。 花園獲得："[action]如果花園沒有準備的敵人：撤退。終於，找到出口了！" 目標 - 如果每位未被擊敗的調查員均已撤退，推進場景。
cards.back_text: If "you took the keys by force," read the following: As you attempt to escape, you are spotted by the nurse you attacked earlier, leading a group of guards. "There they are! Quickly, restrain them!" (→R2) Otherwise, read the following: The guards are too busy controlling the situation and restraining the asylum's patients to notice your escape. (→R3)
cards.back_text_cn:
如果你"強行奪走了鑰匙"，閱讀以下段落： 你正準備逃離時，之前被你攻擊的護士發現了你，她身後帶著一群守衛："他們在那兒！快，抓住他們！" (→結局2)
否則，閱讀以下段落： 守衛忙著管控局勢，綑綁院內病人，全然沒有注意你的逃離。 (→結局3)

cards.name: Asylum Halls
cards.text: [reaction] After you defeat a [[Possessed]] enemy at this location: Draw 1 card.
cards.text_cn: [reaction]你擊敗本地點的1個[[附身]]敵人後：抽取1張卡牌。(FAQ, v2.0)

cards.name: Asylum Halls
cards.text: Each [[Possessed]] enemy at this location gets +1 horror value.
cards.text_cn: 本地點上每個[[附身]]敵人+1恐懼值。(FAQ, v2.0)

cards.name: Asylum Halls
cards.text: [action] Take 1 horror: Evade. Automatically evade a [[Possessed]] enemy at this location.
cards.text_cn: [action]受到1點恐懼：躲避。自動躲避本地點上的1個[[附身]]敵人。(FAQ, v2.0)

cards.name: Asylum Halls
cards.text: Forced - After you end your turn at this location: Take 1 horror and gain 2 resources.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 你在本地點結束回合後：受到1點恐懼並獲得2資源。

cards.name: Kitchen
cards.text: [action] If there are no clues on the Kitchen: Test [willpower] (2). If you succeed, remember that you "set a fire in the kitchen."
cards.text_cn: [action]如果廚房沒有線索：檢定[willpower](2)。如果你成功，記住你"在廚房放了火。"
cards.back_text: The door leading into the Kitchen is locked. You cannot enter the Kitchen.
cards.back_text_cn: 通往廚房的門鎖住了。你不能進入廚房。

cards.name: Mess Hall
cards.text: Forced - After you successfully investigate the Mess Hall: Choose and discard 1 card from your hand.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 你成功調查食堂後：選擇並丟棄你手牌中的1張卡牌。

cards.name: Infirmary
cards.text: [action]: Heal 1 damage and take 1 direct horror, or heal 1 horror and take 1 direct damage. (Limit once per round.)
cards.text_cn: [action]：治癒1點傷害並受到1點直接恐懼，或者治癒1點恐懼並受到1點直接傷害。(每輪限制一次。)

cards.name: Yard
cards.text:
While you are investigating the Yard, it gets +1 shroud for each horror on you.
[action] If there are no clues on Yard, take 1 damage: Remember that you "incited a fight amongst the patients."
cards.text_cn:
你在調查後院時，你每有1點恐懼，這裡+1隱藏值。
[action]如果後院沒有線索，受到1點傷害：記住你"煽動病人互相攻擊。"

cards.name: Garden
cards.text: [action] If there are no clues on Garden: Test [agility] (2). If you succeed, remember that you "distracted the guards."
cards.text_cn: [action]如果花園沒有線索：檢定[agility](2)。如果你成功，記住你"分散了守衛的注意力。"
cards.back_text: The gate leading into the Garden is locked. You cannot enter the Garden.
cards.back_text_cn: 通往花園的門鎖住了。你不能進入花園。

cards.name: Basement Hall
cards.text: Forced - After the Basement Hall is revealed: Put the 4 set-aside Patient Confinement locations into play.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 翻開地下室走廊後：將4張放在一邊的病人拘禁室地點放置入場。
cards.back_text: The door leading into the Basement Hall is locked. You cannot enter the Basement Hall.
cards.back_text_cn: 通往地下室走廊的門鎖住了。你不能進入地下室走廊。

cards.name: Patient Confinement
cards.text: Forced - After Patient Confinement is revealed: Advance to act 2b.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 翻開病人拘禁室後：推進到場景2b。
cards.back_text: As an additional cost to enter Patient Confinement, you must spend 1 clue.
cards.back_text_cn: 你必須花費1線索作為進入病人拘禁室的額外費用。

cards.name: Patient Confinement
cards.text: [action]: Test [combat] (2) to release the patient here from his bonds. If you succeed, he howls like a wolf and tears off through the basement; remember that you "released a dangerous patient."
cards.text_cn: [action]：檢定[combat](2)來釋放這裡的病人。如果你成功，他像狼一樣嚎叫著衝出地下室：記住你"釋放了一個危險的病人。"
cards.back_text: As an additional cost to enter Patient Confinement, you must spend 1 clue.
cards.back_text_cn: 你必須花費1線索作為進入病人拘禁室的額外費用。

cards.name: Patient Confinement
cards.text: [action]: Test [intellect] (2) to speak to the patient here. If you succeed, you are able to interpret her ravings; remember that you "know the guards' patrols."
cards.text_cn: [action]：檢定[intellect](2)來與這裡的病人交談。如果你成功，你終於聽懂了她的胡言亂語；記住你"獲知了守衛的巡邏路線。"
cards.back_text: As an additional cost to enter Patient Confinement, you must spend 1 clue.
cards.back_text_cn: 你必須花費1線索作為進入病人拘禁室的額外費用。

cards.name: Patient Confinement
cards.text: [action]: Test [willpower] (X), where X is the amount of horror on you. If you succeed, you recognize the room; remember that you "recalled the way out."
cards.text_cn: [action]：檢定[willpower](X)，其中X等於你的恐懼數量。如果你成功，你認出了這間房間：記住你"想起了出去的路。"
cards.back_text: As an additional cost to enter Patient Confinement, you must spend 1 clue.
cards.back_text_cn: 你必須花費1線索作為進入病人拘禁室的額外費用。

cards.name: Daniel Chesterfield
cards.text: Prey - Highest [combat]. [action] If you control Clasp of Black Onyx: Parley. You show Daniel the clasp, and he staggers backward, collapsing into a motionless husk. Add him to the victory display.
cards.text_cn: 獵物 - [combat]最高的目標。 [action]如果你控制黑瑪瑙扣環：談判。你把扣環拿給丹尼爾看，他蹣跚著退後了幾步，癱倒在地一動不動。將他加入勝利牌區。

meta.subname: …Or At Least, What's Left of Him

cards.name: Asylum Gorger
cards.text: Spawn - Basement Halls. Hunter. Asylum Gorger cannot make attacks of opportunity, and cannot attack during the same phase it moved from its hunter keyword.
cards.text_cn: 生成 - 地下室走廊。 獵手。 瘋人院暴食怪不能進行趁亂攻擊，不能在其獵手關鍵詞移動的同一階段攻擊。

cards.name: Haunted Patient
cards.text: Spawn - Nearest Asylum Halls. Prey - Most remaining sanity. Forced - When you attack Mad Patient: Take 1 horror.
cards.text_cn: 生成 - 最近的瘋人院大廳。 獵物 - 剩餘神智值最高的目標。 強制 - 在你攻擊發瘋的病人時：受到1點恐懼。

cards.name: Straitjacket
cards.text: Revelation - If there is no copy of Straitjacket in your threat area, put Straitjacket into play in your threat area as an asset that takes up a body slot and 2 hand slots. [action]: Randomly choose 1 enemy from among the set-aside [[Monster]] enemies and place it beneath the act deck without looking at it. Discard Gift of Madness (Pity) from your hand.

cards.name: Walls Closing In

cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 檢定[willpower](X)，其中X等於你所在地點的隱藏值。如果你失敗，你必須從放在一邊的[[怪物]]敵人中隨機選擇1個放在場景牌堆下，不要查看，或者每低於難度一點，便必須受到1點恐懼。

cards.text_cn: 只要你的確信高於疑惑，本密謀卡獲得： "在檢查毀滅目標值時，場上毀滅標記總數的計算改為本密謀卡的毀滅標記數減去本密謀卡以外的其他卡牌上的毀滅標記數，而不是累加。"
cards.back_text: Each investigator disengages from each enemy engaged with him or her and may move to a connecting location. Move The Organist 1 location away from the nearest investigator (to a location with no investigators, if possible).
cards.back_text_cn: 每位調查員解除與所有怪物的交戰狀態，並可以移動到一個連接地點。風琴手朝最近的調查員的反方向移動1個地點(如果可能，移動到沒有調查員的地點)。

cards.name: The Second Night

cards.text_cn: 只要你的確信高於疑惑，本密謀卡獲得： "在檢查毀滅目標值時，場上毀滅標記總數的計算改為本密謀卡的毀滅標記數減去本密謀卡以外的其他卡牌上的毀滅標記數，而不是累加。"

cards.text_cn: 只要你的確信高於疑惑，本密謀卡獲得： "在檢查毀滅目標值時，場上毀滅標記總數的計算改為本密謀卡的毀滅標記數減去本密謀卡以外的其他卡牌上的毀滅標記數，而不是累加。"

cards.name: The Parisian Conspiracy (v. I)
cards.text: Objective - Spend the requisite number of clues to advance. Objective - At the end of the round, if there are 3 or more doom in play, advance.
cards.text_cn: 目標 - 花費所需數量的線索來推進場景。 目標 - 當一輪結束時，如果場上有3個或更多毀滅標記，推進場景。
cards.back_text:
If you spent clues to advance:
You nearly bump into a tall man, his coat and hat as black as his skin is pale. You remember seeing him through the windows of St. Barnabé Church. His organ playing continues to haunt you…
Spawn the set-aside The Organist enemy at the lead investigator's location, (Draped in Mystery) side face-up. Advance to Act 2a - Pursuing Shadows.
Otherwise:
The organ you heard earlier continues to haunt you. No matter where you are, the torturous chords play over and over in your head. Startled, you ask a passerby about the church. "St. Barnabé?" she replies in a thick accent. "There is no such place."
Each investigator takes 2 horror. Spawn the set-aside The Organist enemy at the location farthest from all investigators, (Draped in Mystery) side face-up. Advance to Act 2a - Pursuing Shadows.
cards.back_text_cn:
如果你花費線索推進場景：
你差點撞上一個高高的男子，他漆黑的外套和帽子與他蒼白的膚色形成了鮮明的對照。你記得好像在聖巴拿波教堂的窗後見過他的身影。他的風琴演奏始終繚繞在你心頭……
將放在一邊的風琴手(神祕莫測)面朝上生成在調查員隊長所在地點。推進到場景2a — 聞風追影。
否則：
你之前聽到的風琴演奏始終縈繞在你的心頭。無論你走到哪裡，這和弦聲在你腦中反復演奏，折磨著你。驚懼之中，你拉住一個過路人詢問教堂怎麼走。"你說聖巴拿波？"她用厚重的口音答道，"這裡沒這地方。"
每位調查員受到2點恐懼。 將放在一邊的風琴手(神秘莫測)面朝上生成在離所有調查員最遠的地點。推進到場景2a — 聞風追影。

cards.name: The Parisian Conspiracy (v. II)
cards.text: Objective - Spend the requisite number of clues to advance. Objective - At the end of the round, if there are 3 or more doom in play, advance.
cards.text_cn: 目標 - 花費所需數量的線索來推進場景。 目標 - 當一輪結束時，如果場上有3個或更多毀滅標記，推進場景。
cards.back_text:
If you spent clues to advance:
The organ you heard earlier continues to haunt you. No matter where you are, the torturous chords play over and over in your head. The sensation that you are being watched tugs at your mind.
Spawn the set-aside The Organist enemy at the location farthest from all investigators, (Hopeless, I Defied Him) side face-up. Advance to Act 2a - Stalked by Shadows.
Otherwise:
You nearly bump into a tall man, his coat and hat as black as his skin is pale. He gives you a look of hatred, as intense and as deadly as you have ever seen. You recoil at the mere sight of him, and shadows gather around his feet as he marches toward you.
Each investigator takes 2 horror. Spawn the set-aside The Organist enemy at the lead investigator's location, (Hopeless, I Defied Him) side face-up. Advance to Act 2a - Stalked by Shadows.
cards.back_text_cn:
如果你花費線索推進場景：
你之前聽到的風琴演奏始終縈繞在你的心頭。無論你走到哪裡，這和弦聲在你腦中反復演奏，折磨著你。你始終感覺有人監視著自己。
將放在一邊的風琴手(藐視絕望)面朝上生成在離所有調查員最遠的地點。推進到場景2a — 暗影纏身。
否則：
你差點撞上一個高高的男子，他漆黑的外套和帽子與他蒼白的膚色形成了鮮明的對照。他惡狠狠地看了你一眼，那是你見過最可怕，最致命的眼神。光是看到他就讓你渾身發顫，他朝你步步逼近時，暗影都聚集到了他的腳下。
每位調查員受到2點恐懼。 將放在一邊的風琴手(藐視絕望)面朝上生成在調查員隊長所在地點。推進到場景2a — 暗影纏身。

cards.name: Pursuing Shadows
cards.text: [reaction] After you successfully attack The Organist: An investigator at your location may place 1 of his or her clues on The Organist. (Group limit 1 [per_investigator] times per round.) Objective - If there are 3 [per_investigator] clues on The Organist, advance.
cards.text_cn: [reaction]你成功攻擊風琴手後：你所在地點的一位調查員可以將自己的1個線索放置到風琴手上。(團隊每輪限制1[per_investigator]次。) 目標 - 如果風琴手上有3[per_investigator]個線索，推進場景。
cards.back_text: Check Campaign Log. - If you intruded on a secret meeting, proceed to (→R2). - Otherwise, proceed to (→R1).
cards.back_text_cn: 查看冒險日誌。 - 如果你闖入了一場密會，進入(→結局2)。 - 否則，進入(→結局1)。

cards.name: Stalked by Shadows
cards.text: [fast] Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Either place 1 doom on the current agenda, or automatically evade The Organist. (Group limit once per round.) Objective - Survive three nights. (Do not advance until you are instructed.)
cards.text_cn: [free]以團隊為單位花費1[per_investigator]個線索：在當前密謀上放置1個毀滅標記，或自動躲避風琴手。(團隊每輪限制一次。) 目標 - 熬過三個夜晚。(在獲得指示之前不要推進場景。)

cards.text: [fast] Discard a card from your hand: Gain resources equal to the number of [willpower] icons on the discarded card. (Limit once per round.)
cards.text_cn: [free]丟棄你手牌中的1張卡牌：獲得等同於棄掉的卡牌上[willpower]圖標數量的資源。(每輪限制一次。)

cards.name: Montmartre
cards.text: [action]: Reveal the top card of each investigator's deck. You may play an asset revealed by this effect (paying its cost), under your control. Shuffle each investigator's deck. (Group limit once per round.)
cards.text_cn: [action]：翻開每位調查員牌堆頂的1張卡牌。你可以(花費其費用)打出以此效果翻開的1張支援卡，置於你控制之下。混洗每位調查員的牌堆。(團隊每輪限制一次。)

cards.name: Montmartre
cards.text: [action] Spend 1 resource: Add 1 supply or ammo token to a card you control. (Limit once per round.)
cards.text_cn: [action] 花費1資源：在你控制的1張卡牌上增加1供給或子彈標記。(每輪限制一次。)

cards.name: Grand Guignol
cards.text: Forced - After you reveal Grand Guignol: You must either take 2 horror, or shuffle all non-weakness cards from your hand into your deck, then draw an equal number of cards.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 你翻開大木偶劇場後：你必須受到2點恐懼，或將你手牌中所有非弱點卡洗入你的牌堆，隨後抽取等量的卡牌。

cards.name: Opéra Garnier
cards.text: While you are investigating Opéra Garnier, double the number of skill icons committed to this skill test.
cards.text_cn: 你調查加尼葉歌劇院時，投入本次技能檢定的卡牌上的技能圖標數量翻倍。

cards.name: Opéra Garnier

cards.text_cn: 你調查加尼葉歌劇院時，你技能的基礎值翻倍。

cards.text_cn: 強制 - 你成功調查拉雪茲神父公墓後：本輪結束前你不能離開拉雪茲神父公墓。

cards.name: Canal Saint-Martin
cards.text: [reaction] After you evade an enemy at Canal Saint-Martin: Move that enemy to a connecting location. (Limit once per round.)
cards.text_cn: [reaction]你在聖馬丁運河躲避一個敵人後：將該敵人移動到一個連接地點。(每輪限制一次。)

cards.name: Le Marais

cards.text_cn: [reaction]在你回合開始時，如果你在瑪黑區：抽取1張卡牌。(團隊每輪限制一次。)

cards.name: Le Marais
cards.text: Forced - After you enter Le Marais: For the remainder of the round, you cannot leave Le Marais.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 你進入瑪黑區後：本輪剩餘時間內，你不能離開瑪黑區。

Each enemy at Notre-Dame gets -1 fight and +1 evade.

巴黎聖母院中每個敵人-1攻擊並+1躲避。

cards.text: Aloof. Cannot be damaged. Forced - At the end of the enemy phase: If The Organist is unengaged, move it 1 location away from the nearest investigator (to a location with no investigators, if possible). If it is engaged, disengage it instead.
cards.text_cn: 冷漠。不能受到傷害。 強制 -當敵軍階段結束時：如果風琴手沒有處於交戰狀態，朝最近的調查員的反方向移動1個地點(如果可能，移動到沒有調查員的地點。)如果處於交戰狀態，改為解除交戰狀態。

Hunter.

獵手。

cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 檢定[willpower](3)。如果你失敗，棄掉遭遇牌堆頂上的卡牌，直到棄掉一張敵人。你必須抽取該敵人，或者該敵人(從棄牌堆)攻擊你。如果沒有棄掉敵人，改為受到1點恐懼。

cards.name: Torturous Chords

Each time you play a card, increase the cost of that card by 1 and remove 1 resource from Torturous Chords. If Torturous Chords has no resources, discard it.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 檢定[willpower](5)。如果你失敗，將折磨和弦放置到你的威脅區域，你每低於難度1點，在上面放置1資源。 每次你打出卡牌時，該卡牌費用提升1點，並移除折磨和弦上的1資源。 如果折磨和弦上沒有資源，將其丟棄。

cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 將呆若木雞放置入場，放到你的威脅區域。 每輪中你第一次執行以下行動之一(移動、攻擊或躲避)時，額外花費1次行動。 強制 - 當你的回合結束時：檢定[willpower](3)。如果你成功，丟棄呆若木雞。

cards.text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is the number of locations away from the starting location you are (max 5).
[cultist]: -2. If this token is revealed during an attack, and this skill test is successful, this attack deals 1 less damage.

cards.back_text:
If The Man in the Pallid Mask was defeated:
The Stranger drops to one knee, visibly wounded. Your knuckles whiten with anger, and you shout, "We know about Carcosa and Hastur. Now tell us how to stop this madness!" The Stranger digs his fingers into the cold stone floor, and the catacombs shake…
Mark two Conviction in your Campaign Log. Remove The Man in the Pallid Mask from the game. Advance to Act 3a - The Way Out.
If you spent clues to advance:
Recognizing that the Stranger poses no immediate danger to you, you study your surroundings and the strange shadows twist and distort once more, revealing a strange diagram…
Mark two Doubt in your Campaign Log. Remove The Man in the Pallid Mask from the game. Advance to Act 3a - Leading the Way.
cards.back_text_cn:
如果蒼白面具下的男子被擊敗：
陌生人單膝跪地，顯然受了重傷。憤怒之下，你的拳頭繃得慘白，你吼道："我們知道卡爾克薩和哈斯塔。現在告訴我們怎麼阻止這場瘋狂！"陌生人把手指埋入冰冷的石頭地板中，地下墓穴開始震動起來……

你發現陌生人沒有對你表現出明顯的敵意，便開始仔細研究四周和牆壁上奇怪的影子。他從火把中取出了什麼東西，暗影再次扭曲舞動起來，顯示出一個奇怪的圖文……
在你的冒險日誌上標記2點疑惑。 從遊戲中移除蒼白面具下的男子。 推進到場景3a — 引領道路。

cards.name: Outer Wall

cards.name: Broken Steps

cards.name: Abbey Church

cards.back_text: The path leading to the Abbey Church is blocked. As an additional cost for you to enter the Abbey Church, investigators at Broken Steps must spend 3 [per_investigator] clues, as a group.
cards.back_text_cn: 通往修道院教堂的小道堵死了。垮塌的臺階上的調查員必須以團隊為單位，花費3[per_investigator]線索作為你進入修道院教堂的額外費用。

cards.name: Chœur Gothique

cards.name: Crashing Floods

cards.name: Worlds Merge
cards.text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). If you fail: - If agenda 1c is in play, take 1 horror and discard 1 card from your hand. - If agenda 2c is in play, take 2 horror and discard 2 cards from your hand. - If act 3c or agenda 3c is in play, take 3 horror and discard 3 cards from your hand.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 檢定[willpower](3)。如果你失敗： - 如果密謀1c在場上，受到1點恐懼並從手牌中丟棄1張牌。 - 如果密謀2c在場上，受到2點恐懼並從手牌中丟棄2張牌。 - 如果場景3c或密謀3c在場上，受到3點恐懼並從手牌中丟棄3張牌。

cards.name: Dim Carcosa

If you fail and Hastur is in play, place 1 clue on your location (from the token bank). [elder_thing]: -3. If this token is revealed during an attack or evasion attempt against a [[Monster]] or [[Ancient One]] enemy, lose 1 action.

cards.back_text: Hard / Expert [skull]: -X. X is the amount of horror on you. [cultist]: Reveal another token. If you fail, take 2 horror. [tablet]: -5. If you fail and Hastur is in play, place 1 clue on your location (from the token bank). [elder_thing]: -5. If this token is revealed during an attack or evasion attempt against a [[Monster]] or [[Ancient One]] enemy, lose 1 action.
cards.back_text_cn: 困難 / 專家 [skull]：-X。其中X為你身上的恐懼數量。 [cultist]：再抽取一個標記。如果你失敗，受到2點恐懼。 [tablet]：-5。如果你失敗且哈斯塔在場上，在你所在地點放置1個線索(從供應堆拿取)。 [elder_thing]：-5。如果攻擊或躲避嘗試[[怪物]]或[[古神]]敵人期間抽出本標記，失去1次行動。

cards.name: Madness Coils
cards.text: Hastur cannot be defeated. Forced - If there is at least 3 [per_investigator] damage on Hastur: Advance this agenda.
cards.text_cn: 哈斯塔不能被擊敗。 強制 - 如果哈斯塔上有至少3[per_investigator]傷害：推進本密謀。
cards.back_text:
The investigators must decide (choose one):
 - Any investigator tests [willpower] (4) to snap out of it. If successful, advance to agenda 2a. If failed, you must choose an option you have yet to choose.
 - Any investigator tests [intellect] (4) to remember that you've done this before. If successful, advance to agenda 2a. If failed, you must choose an option you have yet to choose.
 - This can't be real. This can't be real. This can't be real. Each investigator takes 2 horror. Advance to agenda 2a.
 - The investigators faint and awaken some time later. Advance to agenda 2a and place 1 doom on it.
cards.back_text_cn:
調查員必須選擇(以下一項)：
 - 任意調查員檢定[willpower](4)來掙脫幻覺。如果成功，推進到密謀2a。如果失敗，你必須選擇另一個尚未選擇過的選項。
 - 任意調查員檢定[intellect](4)來回憶起這是你曾經的經歷。如果成功，推進到密謀2a。如果失敗，你必須選擇另一個尚未選擇過的選項。

cards.name: Madness Drowns
cards.text: Hastur gets +1 fight and cannot be defeated. Forced - If there is at least 5 [per_investigator] damage on Hastur: Advance this agenda.
cards.text_cn: 哈斯塔+1攻擊且不能被擊敗。 強制 - 如果哈斯塔上有至少5[per_investigator]傷害：推進本密謀。
cards.back_text:
Spawn the set-aside Beast of Aldebaran enemy at the Palace of the King.

cards.back_text_cn:
將放在一邊的畢宿五的野獸生成在王之宮殿。
將遭遇棄牌堆洗入遭遇牌堆。

cards.name: Madness Dies
cards.text:
Hastur gets +2 fight.
Hastur cannot be defeated unless an investigator "know the secret."
cards.text_cn: 哈斯塔+2攻擊。 除非有調查員"知道了秘密"，否則哈斯塔不能被擊敗。(FAQ, v1.3)

cards.back_text_cn: 查看冒險日誌。 - 如果你的確信高於(或等於)疑惑，進入(→結局4)。 - 如果你的疑惑高於確信，進入(→結局5)。

cards.text: Each investigator cannot discover clues. The Man in the Pallid Mask cannot be defeated except by his [action] ability. Objective - When The Man in the Pallid Mask would be defeated by his [action] ability, advance.
cards.text_cn: 每位調查員均不能發現線索。 蒼白面具下的男子只能因為他的[action]能力而被擊敗。 目標 - 在蒼白面具下的男子將要因為他的[action]能力而被擊敗時，推進場景。
cards.back_text: Put the set-aside Hastur (The King in Yellow) enemy into play next to the act deck. For the remainder of the scenario, Hastur is considered to be in play but is not at any location. Remove The Man in the Pallid Mask from the game.
cards.back_text_cn: 將放在一邊的哈斯塔(黃衣之王)敵人放置入場，放在場景牌堆旁邊。本次冒險結束前，哈斯塔視為在場上，但不在任何地點上。從遊戲中移除蒼白面具下的男子。

cards.name: Search For the Stranger (v.III)
cards.text: Each investigator cannot discover clues. The Man in the Pallid Mask cannot be defeated except by damage. Objective - When The Man in the Pallid Mask would be defeated by damage, advance.
cards.text_cn: 每位調查員均不能發現線索。 蒼白面具下的男子除非受到傷害而被擊敗，否則他不能被擊敗。 目標 - 在蒼白面具下的男子將要因傷害被擊敗時，推進場景。
cards.back_text: Spawn the set-aside Hastur (Lord of Carcosa)enemy at The Man in the Pallid Mask's location. Remove The Man in the Pallid Mask from the game.
cards.back_text_cn: 將放在一邊的哈斯塔(卡爾克薩領主)生成在蒼白面具下的男子所在的地點。從遊戲中移除蒼白面具下的男子。

cards.name: The King in Tatters
cards.text: [fast] If there are no clues on your location: Remove each investigator's clues from the game. Flip your location over and resolve the text on the other side. Objective - If Hastur is defeated, advance.
cards.text_cn: [free]如果你所在地點沒有線索：從遊戲中移除每位調查員的線索。將你所在地點翻面，結算另一面上的文字。 目標 - 如果哈斯塔被擊敗，推進場景。
cards.back_text: - If Hastur (The Tattered King) was the version of Hastur that was defeated, proceed to (→R1). - If Hastur (The King in Yellow) was the version of Hastur that was defeated, proceed to (→R2). - If Hastur (Lord of Carcosa) was the version of Hastur that was defeated, proceed to (→R3).
cards.back_text_cn: - 如果擊敗的是哈斯塔(襤褸之王)，進入(→結局1)。 - 如果擊敗的是哈斯塔(黃衣之王)，進入(→結局2)。 - 如果擊敗的是哈斯塔(卡爾克薩領主)，進入(→結局3)。

cards.name: Bleak Plains
cards.text: While you are at Bleak Plains, you cannot play [[Ally]] assets.
cards.text_cn: 你在荒涼平原時，不能打出[[盟友]]支援卡。

cards.name: Ruins of Carcosa
cards.text: Forced - After you discover the last remaining clue on Ruins of Carcosa: Take 1 damage.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 你發現卡爾克薩廢墟上最後一個線索後：受到1點傷害。

cards.name: Dim Streets
cards.text: Forced - After you discover the last remaining clue on Dim Streets: Lose 1 action.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 你發現幽暗街道上最後一個線索後：失去1次行動。

cards.name: Depths of Demhe
cards.text: While you are at Depths of Demhe, you cannot play fast cards.
cards.text_cn: 你在迪蒙深淵時，不能打出快速卡。

cards.name: Palace of the King
cards.text: Palace of the King cannot be flipped over unless Hastur has at least 5 [per_investigator] damage on him.
cards.text_cn: 除非哈斯塔有至少5[per_investigator]點傷害，否則王之宮殿不能翻面。

cards.name: Songs That the Hyades Shall Sing
cards.text:
Deal 1 [per_investigator] damage to Hastur, exhaust him, and disengage him from all investigators.
Flip this card back over. For the remainder of the game, it cannot be flipped over again.
cards.text_cn:
對哈斯塔造成1[per_investigator]點傷害，消耗他，並解除他與所有調查員的交戰狀態。
將本卡牌再次翻面。本局遊戲剩餘時間內，它不能再次翻面。

cards.name: Bleak Desolation
cards.text:
Deal 2 [per_investigator] damage to Hastur.
Flip this card back over. For the remainder of the game, it cannot be flipped over again.
cards.text_cn:
對哈斯塔造成2[per_investigator]點傷害。
將本卡牌再次翻面。本局遊戲剩餘時間內，它不能再次翻面。

cards.name: Stars of Aldebaran
cards.text:
Each investigator heals 3 horror.
Deal 4 damage to an enemy in play other than Hastur.
Remove this card from the game, and replace it with another set-aside copy of Bleak Plains (move all investigators, enemies, and attachments from this location to the new copy of Bleak Plains). Add clues to that copy of Bleak Plains until it has clues on it equal to its clue value.
cards.text_cn:
每位調查員治癒3點恐懼。
對除哈斯塔以外的一個場上敵人造成4點傷害。
從遊戲中移除本卡牌，用另一張放在一邊的荒涼平原代替(將所有本地點上的調查員、敵人和疊加卡牌移動到新的荒涼平原上)。在該荒涼平原上增加線索，直到線索數量等於其線索值。

cards.name: A Moment's Rest
cards.text:
You must decide (choose one):
 - Choose an enemy in play. Exhaust that enemy and disengage it from all investigators.
 - You heal 5 horror.
Remove this card from the game, and replace it with another set-aside copy of Ruins of Carcosa (move all investigators, enemies, and attachments from this location to the new copy of Ruins of Carcosa). Add clues to that copy of Ruins of Carcosa until it has clues on it equal to its clue value.
cards.text_cn:
你必須選擇(以下一項)：
 - 選擇場上的一個敵人。消耗該敵人並解除它與所有調查員的交戰狀態。
 - 你治癒5點恐懼。
從遊戲中移除本卡牌，用另一張放在一邊的卡爾克薩廢墟代替(將所有本地點上的調查員、敵人和疊加卡牌移動到新的卡爾克薩廢墟上)。在該卡爾克薩廢墟上增加線索，直到線索數量等於其線索值。

cards.name: Inhabitant of Carcosa
cards.text:
Each investigator heals 3 horror.
Remove this card from the game, and replace it with another set-aside copy of Ruins of Carcosa (move all investigators, enemies, and attachments from this location to the new copy of Ruins of Carcosa). Add clues to that copy of Ruins of Carcosa until it has clues on it equal to its clue value.
cards.text_cn:
每位調查員治癒3點恐懼。
從遊戲中移除本卡牌，用另一張放在一邊的卡爾克薩廢墟代替(將所有本地點上的調查員、敵人和疊加卡牌移動到新的卡爾克薩廢墟上)。在該卡爾克薩廢墟上增加線索，直到線索數量等於其線索值。

cards.name: The Coffin
cards.text:
Deal 1 [per_investigator] damage to Hastur.
Flip this card back over. For the remainder of the game, it cannot be flipped over again.
cards.text_cn:
對哈斯塔造成1[per_investigator]點傷害。
將本卡牌再次翻面。本局遊戲剩餘時間內，它不能再次翻面。

cards.name: Mapping the Streets
cards.text:
Test [intellect] (3). For each point you fail by, take 1 horror. Deal 1 [per_investigator] damage to Hastur regardless of whether you succeed or fail.
After this test ends, flip this card back over. For the remainder of the game, it cannot be flipped over again.
cards.text_cn:
檢定[intellect](3)。你每低於難度1點，受到1點恐懼。無論你成功或失敗，對哈斯塔造成1[per_investigator]點傷害。
本次檢定結束後，將本卡牌再次翻面。本局遊戲剩餘時間內，它不能再次翻面。

cards.name: The Archway
cards.text:
Test [willpower] (1). For each point you succeed by, heal 1 horror.
Remove this card from the game, and replace it with another set-aside copy of Dim Streets (move all investigators, enemies, and attachments from this location to the new copy of Dim Streets). Add clues to that copy of Dim Streets until it has clues on it equal to its clue value.
cards.text_cn:
檢定[willpower](1)。你每高於難度1點，治癒1點恐懼。
從遊戲中移除本卡牌，用另一張放在一邊的幽暗街道代替(將所有本地點上的調查員、敵人和疊加卡牌移動到新的幽暗街道上)。在該幽暗街道上增加線索，直到線索數量等於其線索值。

cards.name: The King's Parade
cards.text:
Test [combat] (2). If you succeed, exhaust Hastur and disengage him from all investigators.
Remove this card from the game, and replace it with another set-aside copy of Dim Streets (move all investigators, enemies, and attachments from this location to the new copy of Dim Streets). Add clues to that copy of Dim Streets until it has clues on it equal to its clue value.
cards.text_cn:
檢定[combat](2)。如果你成功，消耗哈斯塔並解除他與所有調查員的交戰狀態。
從遊戲中移除本卡牌，用另一張放在一邊的幽暗街道代替(將所有本地點上的調查員、敵人和疊加卡牌移動到新的幽暗街道上)。在該幽暗街道上增加線索，直到線索數量等於其線索值。

cards.name: Steps of the Palace
cards.text:
Deal 1 [per_investigator] damage to Hastur, exhaust him, and disengage him from all investigators.
Flip this card back over. For the remainder of the game, it cannot be flipped over again.
cards.text_cn:
對哈斯塔造成1[per_investigator]點傷害，消耗他，並解除他與所有調查員的交戰狀態。
將本卡牌再次翻面。本局遊戲剩餘時間內，它不能再次翻面。

cards.name: The Height of the Depths
cards.text:
Each investigator heals 5 horror.
Remove this card from the game, and replace it with another set-aside copy of Depths of Demhe (move all investigators, enemies, and attachments from this location to the new copy of Depths of Demhe). Add clues to that copy of Depths of Demhe until it has clues on it equal to its clue value.
cards.text_cn:
每位調查員治癒5點恐懼。
從遊戲中移除本卡牌，用另一張放在一邊的迪蒙深淵代替(將所有本地點上的調查員、敵人和疊加卡牌移動到新的迪蒙深淵上)。在該迪蒙深淵上增加線索，直到線索數量等於其線索值。

cards.name: The Fall
cards.text: You must decide (choose one): - You cannot bring yourself to do what must be done. Flip this card back over. - Realizing what you must do, you step forward and push her. Take 2 horror and deal 2 [per_investigator] damage to Hastur. Flip this card back over. For the remainder of the game, it cannot be flipped over again.
cards.text_cn: 你必須選擇(以下一項)： - 你下不了狠心履行你的職責。將本卡牌再次翻面。 - 你意識到自己的職責，上前一步，把她推了下去。受到2點恐懼並對哈斯塔造成2[per_investigator]點傷害。將本卡牌再次翻面。本局遊戲剩餘時間內，它不能再次翻面。

cards.name: Hastur's End
cards.text:
Remember that you "know the secret."
Flip this card back over. For the remainder of the game, it cannot be flipped over again.
cards.text_cn:
記住你"知道了秘密"。
將本卡牌再次翻面。本局遊戲剩餘時間內，它不能再次翻面。

cards.name: Hastur
cards.text: Cannot be damaged except by story card effects. Forced - At the beginning of the enemy phase, if Hastur is ready: Hastur attacks each investigator, in player order (regardless of their location). If Hastur's attack deals you horror in excess of your sanity, you take 1 damage, as well. [action]: Test [willpower] (X), where X is Hastur's fight value. If you succeed, exhaust Hastur. Any investigator may trigger this action.
cards.text_cn: 不能受到來自劇情卡效果以外的傷害。 強制 - 當敵軍階段開始時：如果哈斯塔處於準備狀態：哈斯塔按玩家順序攻擊每位調查員(無視他們當前所在地點)。如果哈斯塔的攻擊造成的恐懼超出你的神智值，你還要受到1點傷害。 [action]：檢定[willpower](X)，其中X等於哈斯塔的攻擊值。如果你成功，消耗哈斯塔。任何調查員都可以觸發這個行動。

cards.name: Hastur
cards.text: Prey - Most remaining sanity. Hunter. Massive. If Hastur's attack deals you horror in excess of your sanity, you take 1 damage, as well. While Hastur is being attacked or evaded by an investigator with no remaining sanity, treat each [elder_sign], "+1," "0," or "-1" token that investigator reveals as a [auto_fail] token.
cards.text_cn: 獵物 - 剩餘神智值最多的目標。 獵手。龐大。 如果哈斯塔的攻擊造成的恐懼超出你的神智值，你還要受到1點傷害。 沒有剩餘神智值的調查員攻擊或躲避哈斯塔時，該調查員抽出的每個[elder_sign]、"+1"、"0"和"-1"標記視為[auto_fail]標記。

cards.name: Hastur
cards.text: Prey - Most remaining sanity. Hunter. If Hastur's attack deals you horror in excess of your sanity, you take 1 damage, as well. While Hastur is being attacked or evaded by an investigator with no remaining sanity, treat each [elder_sign], "+1," "0," or "-1" token that investigator reveals as a [auto_fail] token.
cards.text_cn: 獵物 - 剩餘神智值最多的目標。 獵手。 如果哈斯塔的攻擊造成的恐懼超出你的神智值，你還要受到1點傷害。 沒有剩餘神智值的調查員攻擊或躲避哈斯塔時，該調查員抽出的每個[elder_sign]、"+1"、"0"和"-1"標記視為[auto_fail]標記。

cards.name: Creature Out of Demhe
cards.text: Spawn - Depths of Demhe. Massive. Forced - When Creature out of Demhe's location or a connecting location is flipped over, if Creature out of Demhe is ready: It attacks each investigator at that location.
cards.text_cn: 生成 - 迪蒙深淵。 龐大。 強制 - 在迪蒙生物所在地點或連接地點翻面時，如果迪蒙生物處於準備狀態：它攻擊該地點中的每位調查員。

cards.name: Winged One
cards.text: Spawn - Bleak Plains. Retaliate. Forced - After a location is flipped over, if Winged One is ready and unengaged: Move it once toward that location.
cards.text_cn: 生成 - 荒涼平原。 反擊。 強制 - 一個地點翻面後，如果長翼者處於準備且未交戰狀態：朝該地點移動一次。

cards.name: Dismal Curse
cards.text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). If you have no remaining sanity, this test gets +2 difficulty. If you fail, take 2 damage (4 damage instead if you have horror on you greater than twice your sanity).
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 檢定[willpower](3)。如果你沒有剩餘神智值，本次技能檢定+2難度。如果你失敗，受到2點傷害(如果你的恐懼大於你神智值的2倍，改為4點傷害)。

cards.name: Realm of Madness
cards.text: Revelation - Discard cards from your play area and/or from your hand with a total printed resource cost of at least X, where X is the amount of horror on your investigator. If no cards are discarded by this effect, take 2 horror.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 從你遊戲區域和/或你手牌中丟棄一定數量的卡牌，且這些卡牌上印刷的費用總計至少為X，其中X等於你調查員身上的恐懼數量。(FAQ, v1.4)如果本效果沒有棄掉任何卡牌，受到2點恐懼。

cards.name: The Final Act
cards.text: Surge. Revelation - If you have no remaining sanity, place 2 doom on the current agenda. This effect can cause the current agenda to advance.
cards.text_cn: 湧動。 顯現 - 如果你沒有剩餘神智值，在當前密謀上放置2個毀滅標記。本效果可能推進當前密謀。

cards.name: Possession
cards.text: Peril. Hidden. Revelation - Secretly add Possession (Traitorous) to your hand. If you have horror on you greater than twice your sanity, you are immediately eliminated and killed. You may commit this card to a skill test at your location. That test automatically fails.
cards.text_cn: 禍害。隱私。 顯現 - 將惡靈附身(背叛)秘密地加入你的手牌。 如果你的恐懼大於你神智值的2倍，你立刻退場且陣亡。 你可以將本卡牌投入你所在地點的技能檢定，該次檢定自動失敗。

cards.name: Possession
cards.text: Peril. Hidden. Revelation - Secretly add Possession (Torturous) to your hand. If you have horror on you greater than twice your sanity, you are immediately eliminated and killed. [action] Spend 5 resources: Discard Possession (Torturous) from your hand.
cards.text_cn: 禍害。隱私。 顯現 - 將惡靈附身(折磨)秘密地加入你的手牌。 如果你的恐懼大於你神智值的2倍，你立刻退場且陣亡。 [action]花費5資源：丟棄你手牌中的惡靈附身(折磨)。

cards.name: Possession
cards.text: Peril. Hidden. Revelation - Secretly add Possession (Murderous) to your hand. If you have horror on you greater than twice your sanity, you are immediately eliminated and killed. [action] Deal 2 damage to an investigator at your location: Discard Possession (Murderous) from your hand.
cards.text_cn: 禍害。隱私。 顯現 - 將惡靈附身(謀殺)秘密地加入你的手牌。 如果你的恐懼大於你神智值的2倍，你立刻退場且陣亡。 [action]對所在地點的一位調查員造成2點傷害：丟棄你手牌中的惡靈附身(謀殺)。
